Application Description

「拦截猫」是一款在设备本地运行的 "骚扰电话" 与 "垃圾短信" 拦截 APP。 它会用本地 AI 识别垃圾短信，通过百万级本地号码库拦截骚扰电话；还支持关键词、号码、号段和地区等自定义拦截规则。 拦截过程在设备本地完成，无需上传短信内容或来电信息，也不会获取任何通讯录数据。 你只需要完成一次设置，剩下的交给拦截猫。 【核心功能】 • AI 垃圾短信拦截 在设备本地识别广告推广、骚扰营销等垃圾短信。无需上传短信内容，没有网络也能继续工作。 • 骚扰电话拦截 通过百万级本地号码库识别并拦截骚扰电话，减少陌生来电打扰。 • 地区与号段拦截 根据地区、号码或号段设置拦截规则，应对不同类型的骚扰电话。 • 黑名单与白名单 支持自定义关键词和电话号码。想拦截的加入黑名单，重要号码加入白名单。 • 自定义来电标记 为电话号码添加专属标签，来电时更容易判断是否需要接听。 • 持续更新 AI 模型和电话数据持续更新，不断提升短信识别与电话拦截效果。 【隐私保护】 短信过滤和电话拦截均在设备本地完成，日常拦截无需上传短信内容或来电信息。 拦截猫不申请通讯录权限，不会读取、收集或上传任何通讯录数据。 如果遇到误分类短信或标记不准确的电话，你可以选择主动提交样本，帮助改进 AI 模型和号码库。提交行为完全自愿，不影响正常使用。 短信样本会在提交时进行脱敏处理，提交的数据仅用于改善识别与拦截效果。 【会员服务】 会员可以解锁 App 内全部会员功能，具体权益和价格以 App 内购买页面为准。 • 连续包月：每月 6 元，自动续订 • 连续包年：每年 48 元，自动续订 • 股东会员：168 元一次性购买，永久使用（限时开放） 连续包月和连续包年会自动续订。确认购买后，费用将通过你的 Apple 账户支付。 如需取消，请至少在当前订阅周期结束前 24 小时关闭自动续订： 打开 iPhone「设置」→ 轻点你的姓名 →「订阅」→「拦截猫」→「取消订阅」 取消后，会员权益仍可使用至当前订阅周期结束。 【其他】 隐私政策：https://c.team/PrivacyPolicy.html 会员服务协议：https://c.team/vip.html

Application Description

Labyrinth City: Pierre the Maze Detective is an adventure puzzle game for children and adults alike! Adapted from the award-winning children's illustration book series by IC4DESIGN and developed by Darjeeling, Labyrinth City takes you on a trip through a fantastic world of underground cities, hot-air balloons, tree-tops and haunted houses. Find your way through each interactive maze, engage with colorful characters, explore hidden pathways, unlock pieces of clues and solve the mystery along the way. 【The Story】 A new case has arrived for Pierre the Maze Detective! Mr. X has stolen the Maze Stone, which has the power to turn the whole Opera City into a maze. Help Pierre and his friend Carmen find their way through the mazes and stop Mr. X before it's too late! 【The Game】 You play as Pierre, Opera City's renowned maze detective, and you must retrieve the Maze Stone stolen by the notorious thief Mr. X! Without you, Opera City is doomed, as the Maze Stone has the power to turn everything around it into an intricate labyrinth. "Beautiful and cute puzzle games are fine and all," I hear you say, "but what about the challenge?". A fine question! In a maze, although there is only one true path to the exit, there are countless trails to hidden treasures and mini-games. So pay close attention while exploring Opera City and you will be pleasantly surprised. 【Features】 - Explore Opera City! Enter colorful worlds teeming with life and intricate details based on the best-selling children’s book series Pierre the Maze Detective by IC4DESIGN - Solve All Mysteries! More than 100 hidden objects and unique trophies to find, engaging puzzles and minigames to stimulate your brain - Interact With the Surroundings! Over 500 interactions possible with the characters, items, and background - Relive Childhood Memories! Each scene is based on a double-page illustration from the original work - Original soundtrack - Save the World! All levels are tied together by an overarching narration that will fill the detectives within us with purpose - Speaks Your Language! Available in English, Chinese (simplified and traditional), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, and Russian

Vocês já está cansado das mesas velhas histórias? Você está interessado em jogos narrativos, romances gráficos, jogos baseados em chat e jogos indie, mas você está cansado da mesma coisa? Se sim, você deveria checar '7Days', um jogo de mistério com romance gráfico e baseado em decisões. '7Days' é um jogo narrativo de mistério com romance gráfico. É um jogo narrativo único baseado em decisões onde o usuário pode criar suas histórias baseadas na escolha que ele fizer. Nós fornecemos a melhor experiência de um jogo narrativo com um enredo de mistério em estilo bate papo, projetado para dispositivos móveis. É um jogo altamente recomendado para você. ■ Jogo explicado Toda escolha muda a sua história. Cada pequena escolha irá mudar seu relacionamento com seus companheiros, e altera seu destino e de seus companheiros nos momentos críticos. Você pode ser o vilão ou um companheiro de confiança. Tudo depende de suas escolhas. ■ Resumo Existem espíritos que foram colocados ao testa para ressurreição no mundo da morte. O mensageiro da morte os atribuiu com a tarefa de se atacarem ou trabalharem juntos. Seu personagem, Kirell, deve completar tambés as tarefas baseadas em escolhas que lhe foram atribuídas. Mas suas tarefas necessitam que outros morram... Você só tem 7 dias O que você irá escolher? Experimente está história que provoca a imaginação agora mesmo. ■ Características do jogo - Estilo quadrinho com gráficos incríveis - Enredo único que alterna entre a vida e a morte - O enredo muda de acordo com suas escolhas - Várias conquistas e desafios ocultos - Episódios e finais diferentes baseados na história - Aventura de texto com uma sensação misteriosa - Enredo excitante ■ Recomendado para aqueles que: - Estão interessados em conteúdo/texto interativo como romances gráficos, jogos narrativos, jogos de bate papo e jogos sociais - São apaixonados por jogos indie como 'Undertale' - Estão procurando por uma jogo narrativo com elementos de mistério e/ou terror - Estão procurando por O jogo e estão cansados dos jogos narrativos de sempre - Estão interessados em diferentes tipos de jogos de aventura Nós também recomendamos 'Underworld Office: Ghost Game', outro de nossos grandes jogos. ■ Nós garantimos a diversão. Baixe e experimente agora Se você encontrar algum problema ou tem alguma sugestão, por favor, envie para nós em help@buffstudio.com. Nós trabalhamos duro para fazer os melhores jogos de aventura, narrativos, indie, restauradores e romances gráficos. ■ Nós precisamos da sua ajuda para fazer jogos narrativos melhores. Por favor, recomende este jogo narrativo para sua família e amigos. Será de grande ajuda para nós.

Application Description

"Cytus II" is a music rhythm game created by Rayark Games. It's our fourth rhythm game title, following the footsteps of three global successes, "Cytus", "DEEMO" and "VOEZ". This sequel to "Cytus" brings back the original staff and is a product of hardwork and devotion. In the future, humans have redefined internet development and connections. We can now easily sync the real world with the internet world, changing life as we have known for thousands of years. In the mega virtual internet space cyTus, there exists a mysterious DJ legend Æsir. His music has an irresistible charm; people fall madly in love with his music. Rumor has it that every note and beat of his music hits the audiences in the depths of their souls. One day, Æsir, who had never shown his face before, suddenly announced that he will be holding the first mega virtual concert —— Æsir-FEST and will invite a top idol singer and a popular DJ as opening performances. The instant the ticket sales began, an unprecedented rush occurred. Everyone wanted to see Æsir's real face. On the day of the FEST, millions of people were connected to the event. At one hour before the event started, the previous world record for most simultaneous connection was smashed. The whole city was on its feet, waiting for Æsir to descent from the skies... Game Features: - The unique "Active Judgement Line" rhythm game playstyle Tap the notes as the judgement line hits them to achieve a high score. Through five different kinds of notes and the judgement line that actively adjusts its speed according to the beat, the gameplay experience is further combined with the music. Players can easily immerse themselves in the songs. - A total of 250+ high-quality songs (50+ in base game, 200+ as IAP) The game includes songs by composers from all across the world, Japan, Korea, the US, Europe, Taiwan and more. Through the characters, players get to play songs from different genres including but not limited to: electronic, rock and classical. We are confident that this game will live up to the hype and expectations. - Over 800 different charts Over 800 different charts designed, from easy to hard. The rich game content can satisfy players of different levels. Experience exciting challenges and enjoyment through the sensation of your fingertips. - Explore the virtual internet world with the game's characters The one-of-a-kind story system "iM" will lead the players and the in-game characters to slowly piece together the story and world behind "Cytus II". Reveal the truth of the story with a rich, cinematic visual experience. Application Description

A collection of small, simple tools, for when things feel too big or complicated Goblin Tools helps turn overwhelming tasks, confusing messages, difficult decisions, and messy thoughts into manageable next steps. This is the official Goblin Tools app associated with goblin.tools. Beware of unofficial copycats. They are not affiliated with Goblin Tools, and some may be misleading or unsafe. Only trust the official app from the verified Goblin Tools publisher. Created with neurodivergent people in mind, Goblin Tools is a collection of tiny, clever helpers for everyday life. It can support people with ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, chronic illness, low-energy days, and anyone who could use a little help getting things done. You get: - Magic ToDo: Break overwhelming tasks into clear, bite-sized steps - Formalizer: Rewrite text to match the tone, style, or level of formality you need - Judge: Get a second opinion on the mood, emotion, or intent behind a message - Professor: Turn complicated subjects into explanations that are easier to understand - Taskmaster: Work through your to-do list one step at a time, without losing focus - Consultant: Compare options and get help making a decision - Estimator: Create rough time estimates for tasks and activities - Compiler: Transform a messy brain dump into an organized list of actions - Chef: Invent recipes using the ingredients you already have Goblin Tools Pro unlocks features that rely on ongoing online services, storage, and continued development, and therefore cannot be sustainably provided for a single fixed purchase price. With Goblin Tools Pro, you can: - Keep your data continuously synced between devices - Create and reuse templates for to-do items - Share the lists you create - Make custom Formalizer tones and use your own voice - Access your history across all Goblin Tools - Use additional Pro features as they are introduced Use Goblin Tools for productivity, planning, communication, decision-making, learning, cooking, and getting unstuck when your brain refuses to cooperate. It is useful for anyone, but especially designed to help untangle the neurospicy challenges of ADHD, autism, executive dysfunction, spoonie life, and more. Purchasing the official app helps keep the Goblin Tools website free and ad-free for everyone, while Goblin Tools Pro supports the ongoing services behind its connected features.

Application Description

Cyber Manhunt is a Cyber-Style, Realistic- Society theme, Story-Rich indie game. The game taked place in the Republic of Alivia with some different theme stories ,but the fate of the characters is closely related in there. It will focus on social issues liking big data, hacking, citizen privacy etc... We want to reveal the profound themes behind the stories with wonderful plots and gamification. And let players pay more attention to Cyber Violence and Privacy Breaches. [Contents] ◆Chapter I: Death of a Programmer The CEO of a company committed suicide by jumping off a building, and claimed that he was extorted tens of millions by his wife. While his wife posted photos of domestic violence on social networks. Who is lying? ◆Chapter II: Invisible Eyes The indecent video of the female college student went viral on the Internet. At this moment, she was already socially dead. Who is the initiator? Who should protect the safety of women? ◆Chapter III: The Evidence Vanishes The student council president, who is both excellent in character and study, suddenly disappeared. The bullying incident made the case more complicated. Who is the murderer and who is the victim? ◆Chapter IV: The Price of Humiliation The female singer has been exposed again! Threatening letters, hype, the suicide of former girl group members... The Internet has set off a public opinion carnival again! ◆Chapter V: Immortal Code When the society is in madness, are you willing to join the Immortal Code to obtain true love and immortality? ◆DLC: Home Sweet Home Behind this seemingly sweet and happy family, everyone has their own secrets, what is the truth hidden behind?! ◆DLC: Hello World! Senior researcher of Titan Dr. Lucrezia died in a terrible car accident on the spot, but the fellow Benjamin took escape from death. But he did not realize that he was about to be involved in a huge conspiracy… [Features] ◆Highly Immersive: Gamers play as a hacker in the game, accepts the commission of the company, and solve dangerous incidents. ◆Rich Gameplay: There are lots of features of Social Engineering in the game, which is including Detecting, Tracking, Puzzles-Solving, Destroying and Hacking etc.. ◆Wonderful Plots: Each chapter in the game will reflect a current hot social topic, such as: Sneak Shot, Cyber Violence, School Bullying, etc... ◆Multiple Roles: There are many different roles in this game with a flash of personality. Their stories would be dug by yourself. ◆Fully Dubbing: All the characters in the game have their own voice actors that make the game experience more immersive. ◆Original Music: There are some original songs in the game, and the lyrics and vocals are all completed by the studio. [Gameplay] ◆Web Search: You should collect basic information about the targets through the Internet search. ◆Database: You can use the database to get deep information about targets. ◆Crack: You would get passwords based on the obtained target's information, and use it to log in to accounts of different platforms. ◆Chat: The exciting thing is that you need to chat with targets by disguise and use the information to get the trust of the target. ◆Phishing: You can send phishing links to hack the targets' hardware devices, and get private information. ◆Picture Analysis: You can get valuable information and relevant clues from pictures. More advanced hacking methods will be unlocked later!
